fact: The SN2025 national digital strategy (2016-2025) reached only 19% overall realisation, 12% of its 69 projects and 36% of its 28 reforms, and the New Deal Technologique with a 2034 horizon and a universal-connectivity objective (OS-3.1) succeeds it.
title: New Deal Technologique: Retrouvez le détail des programmes, projets et réformes
publisher: Présidence de la République du Sénégal
